title: The Clockwork Guard
text: A clockwork soldier still walks its patrol in the ruins, round and round the same broken courtyard, its feet worn a trench into the stone. Its spear is sharp. Its eyes are two cold lamps. It has not seen you yet.

options.label: Wait in the shadows for it to pass, and let it keep its endless patrol.

outcomes.text: It passes, and you slip by. Where it turns, a cog has worked loose over the centuries, good iron if you have room in your packs.

options.label: The cleverest winds it down from behind, before it can turn its lamps on you.

outcomes.text: It stops mid-step, spear raised. Its gears are worth a fortune, and it never sees them taken.
It turns. Its lamps fix on you as its spear comes down.

options.label: Break it, and end its patrol for good.

outcomes.text: It fights exactly as it was built to, tirelessly. It was built very well.

options.label: The Tinkerer opens its back while it walks, hands steady and quick.

outcomes.text: One wire pulled, and it stops mid-step forever. Its insides are worth carrying home.
One wire pulled, and its head turns all the way round.
